entries.def:
Almon = "concealed"
a town in Benjamin allotted to the priests
Another name of a.le.met (עָלֶ֫מֶת "Alemeth" H5964G)

young women, soprano?
a term in psalm heading-Alamoth

Aramaic of e.lam (עֵילָם "Elam" H5867A) 
§ Elamites, of Elam "their heaps"
a native of Elam

Almon-diblathaim = "concealing the two cakes"
a station of the Israelites in the wilderness of Moab
Also named: bet div.la.ta.yim (בֵּית דִּבְלָתָ֑יִם "Beth-diblathaim" H1015)

Alameth or Alemeth = "covering"
a town in Benjamin
Also named: al.mon (עַלְמוֹן "Almon" H5960)
